description: From Yin & Yang Square in the Huangyaguan fortress: a 5 km road climb through Xiaoping'an to the Great Wall, west along the Wall and down the steep Goat Track stairs into the fortress, a long loop of valley roads and villages with three runnable climbs, then back over the Wall in reverse and down the same road to the finish. The Wall is steps a treadmill can't reproduce: its climbs are capped and its descents are flat. Unofficial.

source.notes: The 2026 course: Huangyaguan fortress, the Great Wall, the valley villages, and the Wall again in reverse. The Wall and its stairs come from OpenStreetMap; the valley roads follow OpenStreetMap streets in the order a runner's 2024 track shows, which may differ from the official map by up to about a kilometre in places, so treat the valley hills' positions as approximate. The course is uncertified; distances are scaled to 42.195 km at the Wall's entry point on both passes and the finish. Elevations from the Copernicus 30 m surface model, which reads the Wall's ridge within about 5–20 m. The Wall's stairs are steeper than any treadmill: they are capped, and the descents are flat. Most runners spend about 40% of their race time on the Wall, the part a treadmill reproduces least. Unofficial.
